title: Distinct IRF6 dysfunction mechanisms in syndromic orofacial clefts: Computational evidence for allosteric versus direct disruption.
authors: Franco, Ana Luiza Meneguci Moreira; Antunes, Deborah; Gomes, Ana Clara Rodrigues Moreira; Dias, Bruno Santos de Barros; Cintra, Henrique Pessoa Ladvocat; Guimaraes, Ana Carolina Ramos; de Carvalho, Elizeu Fagundes; Vargas, Fernando Regla; Martinez de Carvalho, Flavia
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子动力学模拟和MM/GBSA计算，解析IRF6转录因子致病突变对DNA结合的直接或别构破坏机制，核心聚焦TF-DNA互作建模，高度匹配课题。
abstract: Orofacial clefts (OC) are a congenital anomaly typically classified as syndromic or non-syndromic. Among the syndromic cases, Van der Woude syndrome (VWS) and popliteal pterygium syndrome (PPS) are primarily caused by pathogenic variants in IRF6, which encodes a transcriptional factor essential for orofacial development. Our aim is to identify and characterize IRF6 variants in two syndromic OC cases and assess their structural and functional consequences through computational modeling. Sequencing of IRF6 exons 3, 4, 7, and 9 was conducted in one proband with VWS and one proband with PPS, as well as their parents. Structural impacts were measured through comparative modeling based on the IRF4-DNA complex, followed by molecular dynamics simulations. Binding free energies and protein-DNA interactions were assessed using MM/GBSA calculations and hydrogen bond occupancy analysis. We identified two pathogenic variants: NP_006138.1:p.(Ala16Val) in a VWS proband and NP_006138.1:p.(Arg84Cys) in a PPS proband, both confirmed as de novo. Variants were classified as pathogenic by the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics criteria, and by most pathogenicity predictors. Molecular dynamics simulations showed that NP_006138.1:p.(Ala16Val) induces long-range allosteric effects with increased structural fluctuations, while NP_006138.1:p.(Arg84Cys) directly disrupts critical DNA-binding interactions. MM/GBSA analysis demonstrated reduced DNA-binding affinity for both variants, with NP_006138.1:p.(Arg84Cys) showing the most severe electrostatic disruption. Our computational analyses suggest that pathogenic IRF6 variants may impact DNA binding through distinct molecular mechanisms: NP_006138.1:p.(Ala16Val) potentially through allosteric conformational changes and NP_006138.1:p.(Arg84Cys) likely through direct disruption of the protein-DNA interface.
abstract_zh: 口面裂（Orofacial clefts, OC）是一种先天性异常，通常分为综合征型或非综合征型。在综合征型病例中，Van der Woude综合征（VWS）和腘窝翼状胬肉综合征（PPS）主要由IRF6的致病变异引起，IRF6编码一种对口面发育至关重要的转录因子。我们的目标是在两例综合征型OC病例中鉴定并表征IRF6变异，并通过计算建模评估其结构和功能后果。对一例VWS先证者和一例PPS先证者及其父母进行了IRF6外显子3、4、7和9的测序。通过基于IRF4-DNA复合物的比较建模评估结构影响，随后进行分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟。使用MM/GBSA计算和氢键占有率分析评估结合自由能和蛋白质-DNA相互作用。我们鉴定出两个致病变异：VWS先证者中的NP_006138.1:p.(Ala16Val)和PPS先证者中的NP_006138.1:p.(Arg84Cys)，两者均确认为新生变异。根据美国医学遗传学与基因组学学会标准及大多数致病性预测工具，这些变异被分类为致病性。分子动力学模拟显示，NP_006138.1:p.(Ala16Val)诱导长程变构效应，增加结构波动，而NP_006138.1:p.(Arg84Cys)直接破坏关键的DNA结合相互作用。MM/GBSA分析表明，两种变异均降低DNA结合亲和力，其中NP_006138.1:p.(Arg84Cys)表现出最严重的静电破坏。我们的计算分析提示，致病性IRF6变异可能通过不同的分子机制影响DNA结合：NP_006138.1:p.(Ala16Val)可能通过变构构象变化，而NP_006138.1:p.(Arg84Cys)可能通过直接破坏蛋白质-DNA界面。
